references.text: The first census of the tribe of Gad also showed 45,650 men, confirming the numbers from the camp arrangement
In the second census on the plains of Moab, the tribe of Gad had decreased to 40,500 men, showing the change over the wilderness journey period
The sons of Gad who went down to Egypt with Jacob, which was the origin of the tribe of Gad
Previous verse introducing the tribal chief of Gad, Eljasaf son of Deuel
